scores.note: negation_changed warns on 1, 3, 4 are false alarms: 'rather than'/'instead of' keep the contrast. 1 is the cleanest formal rewrite. 2 'performing tasks' is vague. 3 'In my view' shifts experience to opinion. 4 'applied to verify' is stiff. 5 barely raises the register and keeps 'for me'.
